description: Camera 0x412 LKAS_HUD byte 4 bit 6 (Motorola start bit 38) and the dash's LTA follow-up cruising display (three dots on the distance bars). Camera frames are the camera's own bus-2 0x412 at 1 Hz, sampled at 10 Hz and joined to openpilot's radarState leadOne. Dash observations are the owner's, with openpilot sending a modified LKAS_HUD.

camera_side.openpilot_steering_during_bit38: yes on every owner bit-38 frame; openpilot's own 0x412 then carried LKAS_STATUS 1, BARRIERS 1, bit 38 = 0

dash_tests.setup: parked, openpilot onroad not engaged, 0x412 = 80 04 0c 00 40 2c 00 02 (LKAS_STATUS 2, BARRIERS 0, bit 38)
dash_tests.dash: LTA indicator green, no cruise display, no dots
LTA indicator white / grey, no dots

dash_tests.setup: driving, cruise set behind a lead, openpilot steering, bit 38 + BARRIERS 0 + LKAS_STATUS 2 (mode 3)
dash_tests.dash: lead car icon, distance bars with the three follow-up dots, green LTA indicator

dash_tests.setup: driving, cruise set behind leads, openpilot steering, BARRIERS 0 + LKAS_STATUS 2 with bit 38 clear (mode 7); log: 1,642 frames of 94 04/14 0c 00 00 2c 00 02 with steering and a lead, about 5.5 min
dash_tests.dash: green LTA indicator, no dots, lane-line highlight off

not_separated: whether bit 38 draws the dots with LKAS_STATUS 1 and BARRIERS 1 (not tested)
verdict: bit 38 draws the follow-up dots (set: dots; cleared with everything else equal: none). BARRIERS 0 turns the lane-line highlight off. LKAS_STATUS 2 turns the LTA indicator green.
